Term1: Brain abscess from contiguous or hematogenous spread
Text:
[Help, legend, allergy info, consults, alternative antimicrobials and more \(Inpt\)](orzid2-gmenu-abx-general-information-inpatient)

# BRAIN ABSCESS FROM CONTIGUOUS OR HEMATOGENOUS SPREAD OF INFECTION

Prior to beginning antimicrobial therapy, when possible, computed topographic

(CT) - guided aspiration or surgery should be performed to obtain abscess

material for determination of infectious pathogen. Adjust antimicrobial regimen

to optimize therapy and treatment duration to optimize therapy based on pathogen

once isolated.

Broad spectrum empiric antimicrobials are indicated initially for brain abscess.

Staphylococcus aureus is a common pathogen. Beta-lactam antibiotics are more

effective than vancomycin for susceptible Staphylococci. If Staphylococcus is

isolated, once methicillin- resistance is ruled out, switch to an

anti-staphylococcal beta-lactam antibiotic. Pseudomonas is a potential pathogen

in post-surgical patients, and those who are known to be colonized with

Pseudomonas.

# Consult Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Infectious Disease

# Duration of Therapy

Duration is typically 6-8 weeks, with the shorter duration for those with

cerebritis only or drained abscess, longer for undrained or encapsulated

abscesses, multiple or loculated abscesses, abscess in an immunocompromised

host.

# Empiric Treatment for Solitary Brain Abscess from Contiguous Source

Preferred:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h \($\) DI](orz-set-abx-ceftriax-2gm-iv-q12h-metro-500mg-iv-q8h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O](psjizid-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h)

# Empiric Treatment for Solitary Brain Abscess from Unknown Source, From

# Hematogenous Spread, Multiple Brain Abscesses or History of MRSA Infection or

# Colonization

Preferred if Pseudomonas is not likely:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h](orz-set-abx-ceftr-2gm-metro-500mg-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

($) [DI] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]

Preferred if Pseudomonas is likely:

[Cefepime 2gm IV Q8h \($$\) R <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h \($\) DI](orz-set-abx-cefe2gmivq8h-metro500mgivq8h-vanco15mg-kgivq12hstat)

<AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O  <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
